verdict.rationale: Pilot keeps clients' books in QuickBooks: customers keep their existing QuickBooks account and historical data, and Pilot says this gives them freedom to choose any tax preparer. That points to data portability and lower lock-in. However, no Pilot-documented export function, open-format output, or offboarding process is evidenced. Missing for 10: a documented full-data export, open formats (e.g., CSV/JSON) rather than the proprietary QuickBooks format, a documented offboarding or handoff process, and independent corroboration of leaving with data intact.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Virtually every tax preparer in the US knows how to work with QuickBooks. You’ll have the freedom to choose any tax preparer you want.
Keep your existing QuickBooks account and historical data
